gloss: rather large; on the large side; largish

definitions.gloss: rather large; on the large side; somewhat big
definitions.explanation: Indicates something is slightly larger than standard or expected. The suffix ～め softens the adjective to mean 'tending toward' or 'on the ... side.'

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me a larger size.
Cut the vegetables on the larger side, okay?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}きめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ワンサイズ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: This shirt is made on the large side, so one size down might be fine.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix ～め to the adjective stem {大|おお}き. The ～め suffix indicates a slight tendency or degree — "somewhat," "on the ... side." Very common in everyday speech, especially when shopping or cooking.

PATTERN — ～め (degree suffix):
Attaches to adjective stems to indicate a slight degree:
- ⟦{小|ちい}さめ→小さめ：21795_chiisame⟧: on the small side
- ⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧: on the generous/large side (for quantities)
- ⟦{少|すく}なめ→少なめ：19120_sukuname⟧: on the less side
- ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧: on the early side
- {強|つよ}め: on the strong side

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}きめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: a larger size
- {大|おお}きめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into larger pieces
- {大|おお}きめ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: oversized clothing
- {大|おお}きめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make on the large side
